[size=5][b]Third-Person Camera[/b][/size]

Replaces Tormented Souls 2's fixed camera angles with a camera behind the character. Look around 360 degrees with the mouse or the right stick.

[b]It changes no game or save file.[/b] Delete the mod folder (or switch "TPS camera" off in the F1 screen) and the game is back to normal.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]360-degree look with the mouse or the right stick; left stick / WASD move relative to the camera.
[*]Aiming swings the camera to the enemy the game locked on to, then you can look around freely.
[*]Movies, scripted events, puzzles and QTEs keep the original camera and hand back seamlessly.
[*]Stays in third person while examining eye-mark objects, climbing ladders, pushing carts and while grabbed.
[*]Right stick click puts the camera behind the character; optional auto-turn behind you while moving.
[*]F1 settings screen: camera position, sensitivity, inversion, dead zone. Settings are saved.
[*]Japanese / English settings screen (follows the game language).
[/list]

[size=4][b]Beta notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The levels were built for fixed cameras: expect some odd views (missing geometry behind the character, low ceilings, narrow corridors).
[*]Not every scene has been tested.
[/list]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Tormented Souls 2 (Steam, Windows).
[*]Gamepad: an Xbox-style controller (XInput) is assumed; button names (A / B / X, LB / RB, stick clicks) are Xbox names. Other controllers are untested (they may work if the game sees them as an Xbox controller, e.g. through Steam Input).
[*]UE4SS, official [b]experimental-latest[/b] build [b]UE4SS_v3.0.1-1217-g4fb9b615.zip[/b] (not the zDEV- one). Not included. Get it here: [url=https://github.com/UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS/releases/tag/experimental-latest]https://github.com/UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS/releases/tag/experimental-latest[/url]
Tested with a clean install of exactly that zip. The older v3.0.0 / v3.0.1 tag releases are untested.
[/list]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Close the game. Install UE4SS: put [b]dwmapi.dll[/b] and the [b]ue4ss[/b] folder from the UE4SS zip next to TormentedSouls2-Win64-Shipping.exe (...\Tormented Souls 2\TormentedSouls2\Binaries\Win64). Skip this if UE4SS is already installed.
[*]Extract this mod's zip, then copy its [b]ue4ss[/b] folder into the same Win64 folder (merge / overwrite).
[*]Start the game, load a save, press [b]F1[/b] for the settings.
[/list]

[size=4][b]Controls[/b][/size]
Gamepad controls are written for an [b]Xbox-style controller (XInput)[/b]; the button names below are Xbox names.
[list]
[*]Look: Xbox controller right stick (RS) / mouse
[*]Move: Xbox controller left stick (LS) / WASD (camera relative). WASD walks; hold Shift to run (as in the original).
[*]Weapon select: Xbox controller D-pad / number keys 1-4 / mouse wheel (next / previous)
[*]Camera behind the character: Xbox controller right stick click (RS)
[*]Flashlight: Xbox controller left stick click (LS) / F (keyboard)
[*]Settings screen: F1 (keyboard). The controls are shown as button icons. Gamepad: D-pad up/down = item, left/right = value, RB/LB = x10, X = reset each item, A = confirm, B = close. Keyboard: arrows, PgUp/PgDn = x10, R = reset each item, Enter = confirm, ESC or F1 = close. Mouse: point to select, click left / right of a value to lower / raise it, wheel = change, right click = close.
[*]Camera position screen: D-pad / arrows = move the camera, LB/RB or PgDn/PgUp or the mouse wheel = nearer / farther, LT/RT or Q/E = FOV, hold X / R = reset all, B / ESC / right click = back.
[/list]

[size=4][b]Uninstall[/b][/size]
Delete [b]Win64\ue4ss\Mods\TS2TPSCamera[/b] (and dwmapi.dll + the ue4ss folder if you want UE4SS gone too). To disable only this mod, delete or rename its enabled.txt.

[size=4][b]Troubleshooting / bug reports[/b][/size]
Open Win64\ue4ss\UE4SS.log and search for [TS2TPS]. The line "[TS2TPS] loaded v0.9.2" means the mod started. Please attach the [TS2TPS] lines when reporting a problem.
